4664.name: In A Large Cavern

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

up.description: To the up lies In The Cave.

4664.description:
This is the highest and rawest corner of the cavern, where a spiral of
worn stone steps climbs into darkness toward a chamber far above. Cold
air drifts down the stair carrying the smell of dead leaves and moss.
The floor is bare grit, and the rock overhead glitters with damp. The
cavern opens on to the west, where a faint glow of lantern light seems
to lie.

4665.name: In A Large Cavern

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4665.description:
A broad junction of the cavern, where three passages meet beneath a roof
hung with pale stalactites. Flowstone has run down the rock in frozen
curtains, and drip water rings in a shallow stone basin. The way east
leads back toward the stair, the cavern goes on west into the dark, and
a damper passage slopes south toward the sound of lapping water.

4666.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4666.description:
A junction in the great cavern, where tunnels of grey stone fan out
beneath a low shelf of rock. Shadows pool along the base of every wall,
and a gentle draught moves between the ways like a sigh. A passage turns
north into a sandy hollow, another goes east toward the lake side, and
the third runs west toward a distant dim glow.

4667.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4667.description:
The cavern floor tilts here toward an arch of dressed stone that someone
has carved into the living rock to the west. Beyond it a pale orange
light flickers on the ceiling, and you can smell oil and woodsmoke. Back
to the east the cavern stays wild, and a way leads north into a high-
roofed chamber. The rock around the arch is carved with a ring of
knotted lines.

4668.name: In A Large Cavern

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4668.description:
A low cavern of dark brown rock, its roof sagging in a heavy curve above
a floor of damp sand. Strange ripples in the sand show where some thin
stream once ran across it. The passage leads south toward a larger
junction and west into a vaster cave. The air is close and warm, like
breath.

4669.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4669.description:
A great vaulted cavern, its dark ceiling hung with long fangs of stone,
spreads around you in all directions that matter. The floor drops in a
wide ledge toward a bowl of shadow in the middle. Ways lead north to a
rock-strewn chamber, east to another cavern, and south toward a wider
hall. Your footsteps return from far-off ranks of rock.

4672.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Small Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4672.description:
The cavern floor is cluttered here with fallen rock, and you pick your
way between the boulders by feel and by lantern gleam. A narrow gap
opens north into a small chamber, and the main passage turns east and
south. Cool air stirs, bringing a smell of wet clay and distant smoke.

4673.name: In A Small Cavern

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4673.description:
A small cavern with a ceiling of pitted rock, where the echo is odd and
flat as if the stone itself were swallowing sound. Hundreds of tiny
cracks run through the floor, and a few thin white roots have forced
their way down from far above. Only one passage leads out, running south
into the main cavern.

4674.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies In A Small Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4674.description:
Three passages meet at this crossing of the cave, and the roof above is
domed like an old chapel. Pale crusts of mineral cling to the stone in
the shape of petals. A narrow side-cave opens east, the main cavern runs
west, and the way north climbs gently toward a pillared chamber.

4675.name: In A Small Cavern

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4675.description:
A tiny side-cave, little more than a pocket in the rock, with a ceiling
you can touch. Someone has swept the floor and laid a ring of stones as
a hearth, long cold now, its ashes grey and old. Soot still stains the
rock above it. The only exit is back west into the main cavern.

4676.name: In A Large Cavern

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4676.description:
A hushed cavern where the floor has been worn into shallow grooves by
passing feet. Stalagmites stand in a crooked row like the teeth of some
buried beast, and water seeps down the rock in glistening threads. A
passage opens east into a chamber with a thick pillar, while the cavern
runs south toward a darker junction.

4677.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies On The Underground Lake.

4677.description:
The floor of the cavern slopes down to a shore of black wet shingle,
where the underground lake begins. Water laps in the dark and the air
tastes of cold iron and minerals. A rotted landing of planks juts out
over the water to the south, and the cavern narrows back toward a drier
passage to the north.

4678.name: On The Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies On The Underground Lake.

4678.description:
You drift on the black water of the underground lake, the shingle shore
of the cavern fading into the gloom to the north. Ripples spread from
your craft and vanish into the dark. Far overhead the roof of the cave
is lost in shadow, hung with pale stalactites that drip into the lake
with a slow, steady plink. The open water stretches on east, cold and
silent.

4679.name: On The Underground Lake

east.description: To the east lies On The Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies On The Underground Lake.

4679.description:
Out in the middle of the lake the dark is nearly complete, and the only
light is a pale shimmer on the swell. The water here is deep and
unnaturally still, and it smells of stone and old rain. You can hear
your own breath come back from the far walls of the great cave. The lake
runs on both east and west of you.

4680.name: On The Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies On The Underground Lake.

4680.description:
The swell is shorter here, slapping at the rock where the lake narrows
toward a ragged shore. Glints of mica in the stone catch what little
light there is and wink like drowned stars. A damp cavern mouth opens on
the shore to the north, and the dark water behind you leads back west.

4681.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies On The Underground Lake.

4681.description:
A narrow beach of gravel and broken shell lies at the water's edge,
where the lake gives way to a cavern floor stained green with algae. The
rock rises steeply on every side and drips constantly. Water slops
softly against the shingle to the south, and a dry passage climbs away
north into the cavern.

4682.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4682.description:
The cavern here is long and narrow, a natural gallery shaped by water
over ages, its roof studded with pale knobs of rock. Scuffed footprints
in the silt show that this passage is used, and not by friends of
strangers. The air is damp and still, and the cavern runs on north,
while a faint smell of the lake comes up from the south.

4683.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Small Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4683.description:
A wide chamber of grey stone where the passage splits around a great
fallen slab of rock. A low opening leads north into a smaller hollow,
and the cavern stretches west toward a brighter, drier darkness. Tiny
crystals sparkle in the roof like scattered frost. The way south goes
back down toward the lake.

4684.name: In A Small Cavern

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4684.description:
A small, round hollow, hardly bigger than a cell, where the roof sweeps
down so low that you must stoop. The floor is dry sand and the rock
around you has been rubbed smooth by many shoulders. A few black scorch
marks on the ceiling show where someone once kept a fire. The only way
out is back south into the larger cavern.

4685.name: In A Large Cavern

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4685.description:
A long, level cavern with a floor of packed earth, trodden into a faint
path between its two ends. Thin veins of quartz thread the rock overhead
and glimmer faintly when the air stirs. Somewhere a trickle of water
echoes. The path runs east toward a split in the rock and west deeper
into the cave.

4686.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In A Large Cavern.

4686.description:
Three ways meet in a rough chamber whose roof is propped by a thick
pillar of natural stone. The pillar is scratched with old tally marks
and the crude sign of an open eye. A passage heads north through the
rock, another runs east, and a third winds on west toward a wilder,
darker cavern.

4687.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4687.description:
The cavern narrows to a crooked throat, its sides pinched in like folds
of cloth. Droplets fall from the ceiling in a thin rain and the floor is
slick with mud. Torch scars blacken the rock at shoulder height, as if
guards once stood watch here. The passage leads north toward a heavier
darkness and south toward the pillared chamber.

4688.name: In A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies The Rough Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4688.description:
A last stretch of rough cavern ends at an iron-banded door set into a
frame of cut stone, the first sign of true masonry among the raw rock.
The door is old, black with age, and its hinges are well greased. The
cavern behind you slopes back to the south, and the door leads on north
into a hewn tunnel.

4689.name: The Rough Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies In A Large Cavern.

4689.description:
Beyond the iron door the cavern gives way to a tunnel hacked out by
picks, its rough walls still showing the bite of every blow. The floor
is level and swept clean, and iron rings are set in the stone for
lanterns. The passage is narrow enough that two armed folk could hardly
pass. It runs back south to the door and the caverns beyond.

21700.name: The Entrance to the Cave Elf Kingdom

north.description: To the north lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Guarded Hallway to the Throne..

west.description: To the west lies Sentry Post.

21700.description:
You stand in a stone gatehall at the threshold of the Cave Elf Kingdom,
a vaulted room cut from the living rock and lit by a lantern hung from
every pillar. Tall doors lie to the north, a broad hallway of pale
polished stone leads south toward the heart of the realm, and a low
archway opens west into a guardroom. The floor is inlaid with a silver
pattern of leaves and knives.

extra_descs.pattern inlay leaves knives:
The silver inlay shows a ring of leaves, each leaf shaped like a knife-
blade, around a closed eye.

21701.name: Sentry Post

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance to the Cave Elf Kingdom.

21701.description:
The Sentry Post is a bare guardroom with a rack of crossbows, a table of
dice and a brazier burning low. A narrow slit in the stone looks over
the gatehall, and a horn of black ivory hangs on the wall to sound the
alarm. The floor is covered in boot-scuffs and spilled ale. The only way
out is east, to the gatehall.

21702.name: The Guarded Hallway to the Throne.

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance to the Cave Elf Kingdom.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance to the Dungeons.

south.description: To the south lies Before the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies Stairwell to the Upper Floor.

21702.description:
A long, grand hallway runs south toward the throne, its high ceiling
lost in glimmering dark and its floor laid with slabs of black stone
veined in silver. Tall lanterns of coloured glass throw jewelled light
on carved pillars. Back north lies the gatehall, a stair rises into the
dark to the west, and a heavy grate opens east onto steps that lead
down. The hall's far end glows with the light of the king's court.

21703.name: Stairwell to the Upper Floor

east.description: To the east lies The Guarded Hallway to the Throne..

up.description: To the up lies Entrance to the Upper Level of the Cave Elf Kingdom.

21703.description:
A narrow stair rises through a shaft of fitted stone, its steps polished
to a shine by countless feet. Lanterns hang from hooks at each turn,
throwing long shadows up the shaft. The guarded hallway lies to the
east, and the stair continues up to the realm's upper level.

21704.name: Entrance to the Dungeons

west.description: To the west lies The Guarded Hallway to the Throne..

down.description: To the down lies At the Bottom of the Dungeon Staircase.

21704.description:
A narrow chamber of iron and chipped stone, where the hallway's grandeur
ends in the grim business of the dungeons. A stair winds down through a
barred archway in the floor, and cold rises from it, smelling of old
straw and wet iron. Chains hang from hooks along the stone. The way west
leads back out to the guarded hallway.

21705.name: Guards Barracks

east.description: To the east lies Before the King's Court.

21705.description:
The Guards Barracks is a long room lined with double bunks of dark wood,
each with its small chest and a hook for a cloak. Racks of spears stand
along one wall, and a trestle table is scarred with knife marks and
dice. The room smells of leather, oil and boiled barley. The only way
out is the door to the east, which leads to the king's antechamber.

21706.name: Before the King's Court

north.description: To the north lies The Guarded Hallway to the Throne..

east.description: To the east lies The War Advisor's Office..

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance to the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies Guards Barracks.

21706.description:
A tall antechamber with a floor of green marble stands before the great
doors of the king's court. Banners of black and silver hang from the
vaulted roof, and tall lamps of crystal throw dancing sparks across the
polished stone. A passage goes north to the guarded hallway, an arched
door opens east, another west, and the grand doorway leads on south into
the court.

21707.name: The War Advisor's Office.

west.description: To the west lies Before the King's Court.

21707.description:
The War Advisor's office is a plain, orderly room lined with maps of
tunnels drawn on cured hide and pinned to the stone. A long table holds
carved markers of every rank, set out in some half-finished battle plan.
A lamp with a green shade burns beside a heap of dispatches. The door
opens west onto the antechamber.

21708.name: North West Corner of the King's Court

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance to the King's Court.

south.description: To the south lies West Side of the King's Court.

21708.description:
In this far corner of the court there is a tall cabinet of dark wood,
behind its glass door a row of ceremonial daggers on red velvet. A tall
lamp on a wrought tripod gives off a steady golden light. The entrance
of the court lies east, and the side of the court continues south.

21709.name: The Entrance to the King's Court

north.description: To the north lies Before the King's Court.

east.description: To the east lies North East Corner of the King's Court.

south.description: To the south lies In the Centre of the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies North West Corner of the King's Court.

21709.description:
The entrance to the King's Court is a lofty hall of white stone and
silver, its roof carried on slender pillars carved like trees. A carpet
of deep blue runs the length of it toward the throne, and lantern light
shimmers in the polished floor. The doors north lead back to the
antechamber, and the court spreads east, west and south.

21710.name: North East Corner of the King's Court

south.description: To the south lies East Side of the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies The Entrance to the King's Court.

21710.description:
In this corner of the court a tall window-shaped niche is inlaid with
coloured crystal that glows from a lamp set behind it. A bench of dark
wood waits beneath it for petitioners. The floor is a pattern of silver
and green tiles. The court's entrance lies west, and the side of the
court runs on south.

21711.name: The Royal Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Corridor.

21711.description:
At the corner of the Royal Corridor the stone gives a deep echo, as
though a hollow lies beneath. A wall of rough black basalt is carved
with a long poem in elf script, picked out in gold. The corridor goes
east toward the court's side and turns south from here. Draughts creep
through the pillars and make the lamp flames lean.

21712.name: The Royal Corridor

east.description: To the east lies West Side of the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Corridor.

21712.description:
A long corridor lined with gilt-framed portraits of cave elf nobility,
each face turned a little aside as though listening. A lamp stands
beneath every painting, trimmed low and burning blue. The corridor opens
east onto the court's west side and runs on west toward a bend. The
scent of old paint hangs in the air.

21713.name: West Side of the King's Court

north.description: To the north lies North West Corner of the King's Court.

east.description: To the east lies In the Centre of the King's Court.

south.description: To the south lies South West Side of the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Corridor.

21713.description:
The west side of the court has a long bench of carved black wood beneath
a row of tall thin windows set with coloured glass, behind which lamps
are lit. The glass paints green and violet bars across the floor. The
centre of the court lies east, the corner north, and more of the side
runs south, while a corridor leads on west.

21714.name: In the Centre of the King's Court

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance to the King's Court.

east.description: To the east lies East Side of the King's Court.

south.description: To the south lies Before the Throne.

west.description: To the west lies West Side of the King's Court.

21714.description:
In the centre of the King's Court a ring of pale pillars rises to a roof
that shines with embedded crystal like a sky of stars. The floor is a
vast mosaic of black and silver, and a fountain of carved stone spills
clear water into a basin in the middle. The entrance lies north, the
throne south, and the sides of the court east and west.

21715.name: East Side of the King's Court

north.description: To the north lies North East Corner of the King's Court.

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies South East Side of the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies In the Centre of the King's Court.

21715.description:
Along the east side of the court, tall pillars carved with climbing
vines support a gallery of smoky shadow. Between them hang tapestries of
cave elf hunts and long marches beneath the earth. The court's centre
lies west, the corner north, and more of the side runs south. A wide
corridor opens east, lit by a row of lamps.

21716.name: The Royal Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies East Side of the King's Court.

21716.description:
The Royal Corridor begins here as a wide gallery of pale stone, its
walls hung with long banners of silver thread. Lamps in glass globes
burn at even spaces and make the floor shine like water. The court lies
open to the west, and the corridor continues east toward a turn. The air
smells of beeswax and polish.

21717.name: The Royal Corridor

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Corridor.

21717.description:
At a bend in the Royal Corridor the stone is carved with a frieze of
cave elf hunters pursuing pale stags through a forest of crystal. A tall
lantern of wrought silver hangs from the roof, and its light shifts as
the draught moves. The corridor comes in from the west and turns to run
south. The floor is soft with a thick runner of blue wool.

21718.name: The Royal Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Corridor.

21718.description:
Here the Royal Corridor passes between a pair of round windows glazed
with thick green crystal, through which the lamplight of hidden rooms
glimmers. The floor is of narrow black and white boards, laid like a
chessboard. Cold drifts up from the stone, and the corridor runs north
to a corner and south toward the arena side.

21719.name: South West Side of the King's Court

north.description: To the north lies West Side of the King's Court.

east.description: To the east lies Before the Throne.

21719.description:
In this back corner of the court a narrow table holds a silver bowl of
dried petals, whose sweet smell fills the air. Lamps hang from the roof
in a low arc, and the stone floor is warm underfoot, as though heated
from beneath. The side of the court runs north, and the area before the
throne lies east.

21720.name: Before the Throne

north.description: To the north lies In the Centre of the King's Court.

east.description: To the east lies South East Side of the King's Court.

south.description: To the south lies At the Throne of the Cave Elf King.

west.description: To the west lies South West Side of the King's Court.

21720.description:
Before the Throne the court's floor is laid with a great mosaic of
silver and jet, a spreading tree whose roots reach down toward the dais.
Tall lamps stand at every pillar, and a thin haze of incense hangs in
the air. The throne rises just south, the centre of the court lies
north, and the court's sides spread east and west.

21721.name: South East Side of the King's Court

north.description: To the north lies East Side of the King's Court.

west.description: To the west lies Before the Throne.

21721.description:
In this angle of the court a statue of a cave elf huntress stands on a
plinth, her stone bow strung and aimed at the gloom. Tall lamps burn on
either side of it and shine on the floor of silver and jet. The side of
the court runs north, and the area before the throne lies west.

21722.name: The Royal Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Corridor.

21722.description:
A straight reach of the Royal Corridor with a vaulted roof painted deep
blue and dotted with gilt stars. Narrow doors of dark wood, locked and
shuttered, stand in the walls like unspoken secrets. Each of your steps
is muffled by the long carpet. The corridor runs north back to the bend
and south toward the arena.

21723.name: The Royal Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Corridor.

21723.description:
A quiet stretch of the Royal Corridor with a ceiling of fluted ribs,
each carved with a leaf and a blade. Tall urns of glazed blue clay stand
in the corners, filled with dried reeds. Sound is muffled to nothing.
The corridor goes north back toward the corner and south toward a bend.

21724.name: On the Stage Next to the King's Throne

east.description: To the east lies At the Throne of the Cave Elf King.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Entrance to the Balcony.

21724.description:
On the stage beside the throne the carpet is thick and dark, and a high-
backed chair of carved ebony stands vacant against the curtained wall.
Silver candelabra stand on every side, and the wax drips in long ropes.
The throne lies east, and a stair leads south to the royal entrance of
the balcony.

21725.name: At the Throne of the Cave Elf King

north.description: To the north lies Before the Throne.

east.description: To the east lies On the Stage Next to the King's Throne.

south.description: To the south lies The Secret Stairwell behind the Throne.

west.description: To the west lies On the Stage Next to the King's Throne.

21725.description:
The Throne of the Cave Elf King stands on a high dais of white stone, a
great seat of black iron inlaid with silver and set with a ring of
sapphires that glow in the lamplight. Wall-hangings of crimson and
violet frame it, and a stair of nine steps descends to the court. Stage
platforms lie to the east and west, while a small iron-banded door
behind the throne leads south.

extra_descs.throne sapphires dais:
The sapphires are set in a ring around the throne's back, one for each
king of the line. The newest is smaller than the rest and stained at the
edge.

21726.name: On the Stage Next to the King's Throne

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Entrance to the Balcony.

west.description: To the west lies At the Throne of the Cave Elf King.

21726.description:
A raised stage of black marble, spread with a rich carpet, curves around
one flank of the throne. Brass candlesticks taller than a man burn at
its edge, and a low rail of silver chain keeps off petitioners. Behind
you the steps lead south to the balcony, and the throne itself rises
just west.

21727.name: The Royal Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Corridor.

21727.description:
Here the corridor is lined with plinths holding busts of past kings,
each with a circlet of beaten silver and a face cold with pride. The
lamps burn lower in this stretch, and the shadows between the plinths
seem to stir. A cold breath comes up the corridor from the arena, which
lies south, while the way north returns toward the court.

21728.name: The Royal Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Corridor.

21728.description:
The corridor turns a corner here, and the lamps on the turn are
brighter, shining on a tall mirror of polished silver. In it you see
yourself small and dim against the vault. A faint roar from the arena
comes down the passage that heads east, and the way north leads back
along the corridor.

21729.name: The Royal Corridor

east.description: To the east lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Corridor.

21729.description:
The corridor ends in a short run of steps worn by the feet of nobles on
their way to the games. Torches in rings of black iron light the stone,
and a coloured pennant hangs at the head of the passage. The corridor
runs west, and the balcony opens to the east in a wash of noise.

21730.name: The Secret Stairwell behind the Throne

north.description: To the north lies At the Throne of the Cave Elf King.

up.description: To the up lies Atop of a Secret Stairwell.

21730.description:
Behind the throne a narrow stairwell of black stone curls upward in the
dark, its steps worn and shallow. The walls are close and smell of lamp
oil and age. A door of iron-banded oak stands open at the north end,
leading back to the throne room, and the steps rise steeply above you.

21731.name: The Royal Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

21731.description:
A short passage ends at a heavy arched doorway where the corridor opens
onto the noise and light of the balcony. Rich curtains of black velvet
are tied back with silver cord, and the floor changes from tile to
boards of dark polished wood. The corridor runs east, and the balcony
stretches before you to the west. Voices drift up from below.

21732.name: The Royal Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Corridor.

21732.description:
The Royal Corridor bends again, and a faint roar rolls down it from the
arena like thunder in a distant sky. A great mural of a duel on white
sand covers the wall, its colours dim with soot. A rack of unlit torches
stands beside it. The corridor comes in from the north and runs west
toward the sound.

21733.name: Atop of a Secret Stairwell

north.description: To the north lies A Heavily Guarded Landing.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Stairwell behind the Throne.

21733.description:
At the head of the secret stair a tiny landing of black stone is lit by
a single hooded lamp. The air here is warmer and smells of musk and
clean linen, a world away from the stairwell's chill. The steps lead
down behind you, and a short passage opens ahead to the north, where the
king's household keeps its watch. Faint footsteps patrol beyond the
stone.

21734.name: A Heavily Guarded Landing

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Bed Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies Atop of a Secret Stairwell.

21734.description:
A Heavily Guarded Landing, floored with thick carpet and walled in
panels of dark wood carved with watching eyes. Two tall stands hold
racks of long polearms, and the lamps above are shuttered against any
who might hide in their glare. A heavy door of black oak and silver
leads north to the royal chamber, while the secret stair lies south.

21735.name: The Royal Nursery

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Bed Chamber.

21735.description:
The Royal Nursery is a hushed room with a ceiling painted as a night sky
and a cradle of carved white wood hanging from silver chains. Small
wooden toys, painted with scarlet and gold, lie on a rug of thick wool.
A night lamp burns low in a glass dish, and the only door opens east to
the royal bed chamber.

21736.name: The Royal Bed Chamber

east.description: To the east lies The Queen's Private Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies A Heavily Guarded Landing.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Nursery.

21736.description:
The Royal Bed Chamber is a lofty room hung with drapes of deep violet
and silver, its vast bed set on a platform of pale wood. Soft rugs cover
the floor and a hearth of carved stone holds the red ashes of last
night's fire. Doors lead east to the queen's rooms and west to the
nursery, while the landing lies south.

21737.name: The Queen's Private Chamber

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Bed Chamber.

21737.description:
The Queen's Private Chamber is a delicate room of pearl-grey stone,
softened by silks the colour of dusk and cushions embroidered with
moths. A mirror in a silver frame shows the room's lamps as pale stars,
and a table is spread with little glass bottles of scent. The door west
leads back to the royal bed chamber.

21738.name: Entrance to the Upper Level of the Cave Elf Kingdom

east.description: To the east lies The Streets of Leisure.

down.description: To the down lies Stairwell to the Upper Floor.

21738.description:
At the top of the stair a broad landing opens onto the upper level of
the Cave Elf Kingdom, where the roof soars higher and the lamps are
many. A statue of an elven huntress stands in an alcove, her cloak
carved in rippling stone. Polished steps lead down behind you, and a
lamplit street opens east.

21739.name: The Streets of Leisure

south.description: To the south lies The Streets of Leisure.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance to the Upper Level of the Cave Elf Kingdom.

21739.description:
The Streets of Leisure begin here, a wide lane of pale flagstones lit by
hanging lamps of coloured glass in the cavern's high ceiling. Fronts of
carved stone line the street, their windows glowing, and the sound of a
distant lute drifts by. A stair lies west, and the street runs on south
toward a busier crossing. The air is cool and sweet with spiced smoke.

21740.name: The Swimming Baths

east.description: To the east lies The Streets of Leisure.

21740.description:
The Swimming Baths are a great pool of clear green water in a hall of
white tile, steaming faintly from some hot spring below. Benches of
smooth stone line the edge and towels of grey linen hang on pegs. The
water laps softly and the echo is warm and humid. The only way out is
east, back to the street.

21741.name: The Streets of Leisure

north.description: To the north lies The Streets of Leisure.

east.description: To the east lies Glork's Taverna.

south.description: To the south lies The Trading Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies The Swimming Baths.

21741.description:
A crossing in the heart of the Streets of Leisure, where a fountain in
the shape of a stone fish spills water into a wide basin. Strings of
paper lanterns criss-cross the cavern air, and the cobbles are worn
smooth. A tavern lies east, the baths west, the trading halls south, and
the street goes back north.

21742.name: Glork's Taverna

west.description: To the west lies The Streets of Leisure.

21742.description:
Glork's Taverna is a low, warm room full of round tables and mismatched
stools, its beams hung with copper pots and dried mushrooms. A bar of
dark rock runs along one side, shining with spilled drink, and a fire of
glowing coals burns in a pit at the room's heart. The smell of roast
meat, fungus ale and woodsmoke is heavy. The only door opens west onto
the street.

21743.name: The Trading Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Trading Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies Mythor's Specialities.

21743.description:
At the far end of the market the stalls thin out, and a ragged curtain
of leather hangs from a rail over an alcove of half-seen goods. The
cavern wall curves round here, damp and glinting. The chambers lead
east, and a plain door south opens on a dealer in oddities.

21744.name: The Trading Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Trading Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies Questor's Weapons.

west.description: To the west lies The Trading Chambers.

21744.description:
A trading hall with an arched ceiling where the stalls sell dyes, spices
and little boxes of carved bone. Dust shines in the lamp beams, and the
cobbles are worn into gentle hollows. The chambers continue east and
west, while a door south opens on a seller of arms.

21745.name: The Trading Chambers

north.description: To the north lies The Streets of Leisure.

east.description: To the east lies The Trading Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies Valorin's Armours.

west.description: To the west lies The Trading Chambers.

21745.description:
The Trading Chambers open here into a high hall divided by pillars of
pale stone and lit by hanging lanterns. Stalls and counters line the
floor, laden with cloth, tools and glassware. Voices haggle in the elven
tongue and coins ring on stone. A shop opens south, the street lies
north, and the chambers run on east and west.

21746.name: The Trading Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Trading Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies Lanthar's Magics.

west.description: To the west lies The Trading Chambers.

21746.description:
A busy chamber in the market, where the floor is strewn with straw from
unpacked crates and the roof is hung with brass scales. Banners over the
stalls mark the guilds of the cave elves in black, green and silver. The
chambers continue east and west, and a doorway south leads to a seller
of magic.

21747.name: The Trading Chambers

south.description: To the south lies Mythelarin's Resthouse.

west.description: To the west lies The Trading Chambers.

21747.description:
At the market's far end the hall narrows, and the stalls give way to a
row of sacks and barrels stacked to the roof. A porter's trolley rests
against a pillar, its wheels thick with mud. The chambers lead west, and
a low door to the south opens on an inn with a sign of a crescent moon.

21748.name: Mythor's Specialities

north.description: To the north lies The Trading Chambers.

21748.description:
Mythor's Specialities is a jumble of odd wares: stuffed cave fish, glass
eyes, lacquered bones and maps of tunnels no one has walked. Shelves
climb to the ceiling and a rolling ladder rests against them. Dust motes
drift in a single beam of lamplight. The door north returns to the
trading chambers.

21749.name: Questor's Weapons

north.description: To the north lies The Trading Chambers.

21749.description:
Questor's Weapons is a cramped shop crowded with blades, spears and
bows, hung upon every inch of the stone. A grindstone stands by the
counter with a puddle of dark water beneath it, and a rack of arrows
bristles from a barrel. The smell of steel and oil is sharp. The door
north leads out to the trading chambers.

21750.name: Valorin's Armours

north.description: To the north lies The Trading Chambers.

21750.description:
Valorin's Armours is a smithy-shop where mail shirts hang from a beam
like gleaming fish and shields of beaten bronze line the stone. A
bellows stands cold in one corner next to an anvil scarred with hammer-
marks. The smell of oil and hot metal lingers. The door leads north to
the trading chambers.

21751.name: Lanthar's Magics

north.description: To the north lies The Trading Chambers.

21751.description:
Lanthar's Magics is a shop crowded with shelves of bottles, stoppered
jars and bundles of dried herbs. Lamps of green crystal give a sickly
glow, and a heavy volume lies open on a stand by the counter. The air
tingles, smelling of sulphur and cold iron. The way out is north into
the trading chambers.

21752.name: Mythelarin's Resthouse

north.description: To the north lies The Trading Chambers.

21752.description:
Mythelarin's Resthouse is a quiet chamber of beds with curtains of grey
wool, each in its own recess in the stone. The floor is covered in rush
mats, and a lamp of horn and brass burns on a high shelf. A sleeper's
cough or a snore sounds now and then through the curtains. The door
north leads out into the trading chambers.

21753.name: At the Bottom of the Dungeon Staircase

west.description: To the west lies In the Dungeon.

up.description: To the up lies Entrance to the Dungeons.

21753.description:
At the foot of the dungeon staircase the stone is worn into hollows by
generations of prisoners dragged down it. A single lantern burns in an
iron cage, guttering in the damp. The air is thick and cold, and the
steps climb up behind you toward the hallway above, while a dim passage
leads west into the cells.

21754.name: In the Dungeon

east.description: To the east lies At the Bottom of the Dungeon Staircase.

south.description: To the south lies In the Dungeon.

west.description: To the west lies The Office of the Dungeon Keeper.

21754.description:
A guard passage in the dungeon, its low roof shored by black beams and
its floor lined with rushes gone foul and brown. Keys and manacles hang
from a rack on the stone, rusted but well oiled at their hinges. The
stair back up lies east, a door opens west into the keeper's office, and
the passage continues south between cells.

21755.name: The Office of the Dungeon Keeper

east.description: To the east lies In the Dungeon.

21755.description:
The dungeon keeper's office is a cluttered cell with a heavy desk of
black wood and a ledger bound in cracked leather. Keys hang by the
hundred on pegs along the stone, and a squat iron stove warms the room.
A worn chair with a split cushion sits behind the desk. The door opens
east onto the dungeon passage.

21756.name: In a Dungeon Cell

east.description: To the east lies In the Dungeon.

21756.description:
A bleak cell with an iron grille set high in the wall and a floor of
broken flags. The floor carries a bitter smell of old smoke, and burn
marks scar the stone in one corner. There is a rack of iron hooks by the
door, which opens east onto the passage.

21757.name: In the Dungeon

north.description: To the north lies In the Dungeon.

east.description: To the east lies In a Dungeon Cell.

south.description: To the south lies In the Dungeon.

west.description: To the west lies In a Dungeon Cell.

21757.description:
A crossing of dungeon passages where the stone is stained dark with
centuries of damp. Heavy doors of iron-studded timber face each other
east and west, each pierced by a narrow grille at the height of a face.
A lantern on a hook sways in the draught and sets the shadows crawling.
The passage runs on north toward the stair and south between more cells.

21758.name: In a Dungeon Cell

west.description: To the west lies In the Dungeon.

21758.description:
A cramped cell of black stone, hardly three paces across, with a shelf
of rock for a bed and a drain in the floor. Scratches cover the wall,
tallies of days and names of those who despaired. The air is stale and
cold, and the thick door swings shut on the passage to the west.

21759.name: In a Dungeon Cell

east.description: To the east lies In the Dungeon.

21759.description:
A cell that seems newer than its neighbours, its stone still sharp and
its straw still fairly clean. A bucket and a tin cup rest by the door,
and a thin blanket lies folded on a bench. Someone has tried to scratch
a window into the rock above the bed, without success. The door leads
east.

21760.name: In the Dungeon

north.description: To the north lies In the Dungeon.

east.description: To the east lies In a Dungeon Cell.

south.description: To the south lies In the Dungeon.

west.description: To the west lies In a Dungeon Cell.

21760.description:
Here the dungeon passage is lined with a long iron rail where prisoners
were once chained for questioning. The floor slopes slightly toward a
central gutter that runs with a thin trickle of foul water. Doors stand
east and west, their locks heavy and clean of rust. More passage runs
north and south along the cells.

21761.name: In a Dungeon Cell

west.description: To the west lies In the Dungeon.

21761.description:
A tiny stone cell, its single window a slit that looks only onto the
bare rock of the passage. Straw lies in a rotted heap in the corner and
a rusted ring is set into the wall at knee height. The door on the west
side gives the only way out.

21762.name: In a Dungeon Cell

east.description: To the east lies In the Dungeon.

21762.description:
The smallest of the dungeon cells, hardly big enough to lie down in.
Water collects in a corner where the stone has cracked, and a thin green
moss grows in the damp. A rough bench has been hacked from the rock, and
the walls are scored with prayers in an elf script. The door opens east.

21763.name: In the Dungeon

north.description: To the north lies In the Dungeon.

east.description: To the east lies In a Dungeon Cell.

south.description: To the south lies In the Dungeon.

west.description: To the west lies In a Dungeon Cell.

21763.description:
A broad stretch of the dungeon where the ceiling rises to a rough vault,
and chains dangle from rings above a stained flagstone. Grilled doors
face one another east and west. A smell of tallow and old sweat lingers,
and a draught moves along the passage that goes north and south from
here.

21764.name: In a Dungeon Cell

west.description: To the west lies In the Dungeon.

21764.description:
A narrow cell with a ceiling so low that even a short elf must bow. The
walls sweat, and a broken wooden bowl lies by a rough pallet of stone.
Someone has carved a crooked picture of the sun above the bed, and then,
in a different hand, scratched it out. The door leads out to the west.

21765.name: In a Dungeon Cell

east.description: To the east lies In the Dungeon.

21765.description:
A dismal cell whose walls are pocked where something sharp was driven in
again and again. A heap of mouldering straw fills one corner and a pair
of rusting shackles dangles from the wall. Dim light from the passage
creeps in through the grille. The door lies to the east.

21766.name: In the Dungeon

north.description: To the north lies In the Dungeon.

east.description: To the east lies In a Dungeon Cell.

south.description: To the south lies In the Dungeon.

west.description: To the west lies In a Dungeon Cell.

21766.description:
The passage widens into a small guard post, with a plank table bolted to
the floor and a bench worn smooth by waiting. A board on the wall bears
a column of chalked numbers, one for each cell. Doors face each other
east and west, and the dungeon runs north toward the stair and south
toward larger rooms.

21767.name: In a Dungeon Cell

west.description: To the west lies In the Dungeon.

21767.description:
An airless cell with walls of grey stone, damp beneath your fingers and
furred with pale mould. A rusting bucket stands in one corner and a
fringe of old chain lies on the floor like a dead snake. The cell door
opens west onto the passage.

21768.name: Arena Holding Chamber

east.description: To the east lies In the Dungeon.

south.description: To the south lies Champion's Tunnel to the Arena.

21768.description:
A second holding chamber, smaller than the other, with a ring of iron
stools and a long table scattered with whetstones and rags. Oil lamps
burn low in niches, and the floor is hard-packed earth. A passage opens
east toward the dungeon hall, and another heads south down to the
champion's tunnel.

21769.name: In the Dungeon

north.description: To the north lies In the Dungeon.

east.description: To the east lies Arena Holding Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies Arena Holding Chamber.

21769.description:
The dungeon passage ends in a broader hall lit by torches in iron
cressets, whose heat is a welcome change from the cold cells. The floor
is trampled flat and sprinkled with sand, as if to soak up blood. A
chamber opens east and another west, both leading toward the roar of the
arena, and the cells lie back north.

21770.name: Arena Holding Chamber

south.description: To the south lies Challenger's Tunnel to the Arena.

west.description: To the west lies In the Dungeon.

21770.description:
A bare holding chamber where those bound for the arena wait, with stone
benches ringed by iron staples and a rack of blunt practice weapons
along the rock. The sand underfoot is stained rust brown, and the noise
of the crowd comes down the tunnel to the south like the beat of a great
drum. The dungeon lies back west. Nothing here is meant to be
comfortable.

21771.name: Champion's Tunnel to the Arena

north.description: To the north lies Arena Holding Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Arena of Champions.

21771.description:
This sloping tunnel is the champions' way to the sand, its walls
polished by the shoulders of heroes. Banners of the king's household
hang from iron poles, stiff with dust. The tunnel opens east onto the
arena floor, while a passage leads north back to the holding chambers.
Even here you hear the crowd's roar like surf.

21772.name: Challenger's Tunnel to the Arena

north.description: To the north lies Arena Holding Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Arena of Champions.

21772.description:
A long, sloping tunnel of rough stone leads toward the sand of the
arena, its roof low and its floor scattered with sawdust. Torches smoke
in their brackets and every footstep rings. The hall of the holding
chamber lies north, and the tunnel opens west onto a blaze of lantern
light and a rumble of voices. The air smells of sweat, oil and sand.

21773.name: The Corner of the Balcony

north.description: To the north lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

east.description: To the east lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

21773.description:
At this corner of the balcony the rail curves in a quarter-circle above
the arena, and the carvings on it are worn smooth by the leaning arms of
onlookers. A single lantern hangs from the roof. The sand glimmers far
below, and the noise of the games is lessened by the corner's curve. The
balcony continues north and east.

21774.name: On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Entrance to the Balcony.

south.description: To the south lies The Corner of the Balcony.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Corridor.

21774.description:
On this stretch of the balcony the carved rail looks down on the arena,
and the pale sand glints far below in the lantern light. Plush benches,
worn at the edges, face the sands in tiers. The noise of the crowd rolls
up the stone, loud enough to numb the ear. The balcony runs north toward
the royal entrance and south toward a corner, and the corridor lies
west.

21775.name: The Royal Entrance to the Balcony

north.description: To the north lies On the Stage Next to the King's Throne.

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Seats on the Balcony.

south.description: To the south lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

21775.description:
The Royal Entrance to the Balcony is a gilded archway with a pair of
great doors thrown open and fixed with chains. A thick carpet of crimson
leads toward the stage near the throne in the north, while a row of
seats opens east. The balcony lies to the south. The smell of oil and
sweat from the arena drifts up.

21776.name: On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena

east.description: To the east lies The Corner of the Balcony.

west.description: To the west lies The Corner of the Balcony.

21776.description:
A long, straight reach of the balcony, with benches of cold stone set
back from the rail. Faded pennants hang from the ceiling, black and
silver, stirring in the drafts. The sand of the arena glimmers far
below. The balcony runs east to its corner and west to the opposite
corner.

21777.name: The Royal Seats on the Balcony

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Entrance to the Balcony.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Entrance to the Balcony.

21777.description:
The Royal Seats are a row of cushioned chairs of dark leather set along
the balcony rail, each with its own small table of black glass. A canopy
of dark silk hangs overhead, tasselled with silver. The arena glitters
below, and a rumble of the crowd reaches the high seats. The entrance to
the balcony lies on either side, east and west.

21778.name: The Corner of the Balcony

north.description: To the north lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

west.description: To the west lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

21778.description:
At the farthest corner of the balcony the rail turns back on itself, and
a shabby bench is wedged into the angle. A lantern in a cage of iron
gives the only light, and the roar of the arena sounds hollow. Cobwebs
hang from the rail. The balcony runs north and west.

21779.name: On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Entrance to the Balcony.

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Corner of the Balcony.

21779.description:
This is the heart of the balcony overlooking the arena, a gallery of
carved stone rail and deep cushioned benches. Far below, the pale sand
of the arena shines in the light of great hanging lanterns, and the roar
of the crowd breaks over you in waves. A passage runs north toward the
royal entrance, another south to the balcony's corner, and the corridor
lies east.

21780.name: The Royal Entrance to the Balcony

north.description: To the north lies On the Stage Next to the King's Throne.

south.description: To the south lies On the Balcony Overlooking the Arena.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Seats on the Balcony.

21780.description:
The Royal Entrance to the Balcony is a small arch of gilded stone,
guarded by a pair of pillars wrapped in carved vines. A rail of polished
wood looks down on the arena in the cavern's gloom. The stage by the
throne lies north, the balcony runs south, and a row of royal seats
stretches west.

21782.name: In A Large Cavern

east.description: To the east lies In A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance to the Cave Elf Kingdom.

21782.description:
The last wild cavern before the cave elves' threshold is swept clean,
its roof blackened by torch smoke. A heavy door of iron-bound black
timber stands in the stone to the south, with a spyhole in it at the
height of an elf's eye. Fresh lantern oil stains the floor beneath a
bracket. The cavern opens back east, rough and unlit.

21793.name: The Arena of Champions

east.description: To the east lies Challenger's Tunnel to the Arena.

west.description: To the west lies Champion's Tunnel to the Arena.

down.description: To the down lies The Hall of Champions.

21793.description:
The Arena of Champions is a vast oval pit of pale sand ringed by rising
tiers of carved seats, all lit by great lanterns hung from chains in the
cavern roof. The floor is scarred with old sword cuts and dark stains,
and the voices of a thousand watchers seem to hang in the stone. Tunnels
open to the east and west, and a heavy trapdoor leads down into the Hall
of Champions beneath the sand.

21794.name: The Hall of Champions

east.description: To the east lies The Hall of Champions.

up.description: To the up lies The Arena of Champions.

21794.description:
Below the arena lies the Hall of Champions, a long hall of black marble
where the names of victors are cut into the walls in silver. Lamps burn
on tall stands, throwing a warm shine over the polished floor. Behind
you a stair climbs up to the sand, and the hall stretches on east
between rows of carved pillars.

21795.name: The Hall of Champions

east.description: To the east lies The Hall of Champions.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall of Champions.

21795.description:
A stretch of the hall where life-size statues of cave elf champions
stand in niches, each holding the weapon that won him fame. Their stone
eyes are inlaid with chips of jet that catch the lamplight. The silver
names beneath each figure are worn from the touch of hopeful hands. The
hall continues east and west.

21796.name: The Hall of Champions

east.description: To the east lies The Hall of Champions.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall of Champions.

21796.description:
The hall's middle length is hung with trophies: shields cloven in two,
broken swords, and the horned helms of beaten giants. A long mosaic in
the floor shows the first duel in the arena in tiny coloured stones.
Soft lamplight shimmers on the pillars. You may walk on east or turn
back west.

21797.name: The Hall of Champions

east.description: To the east lies The Hall of Champions.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall of Champions.

21797.description:
Here the hall's floor rises in a shallow step and the air grows quieter,
as if the stone were listening. Alcoves on either side hold small stone
benches where old fighters once sat to rest. Incense has soaked into the
walls, faint and sweet. The hall leads on east toward a brighter light,
and back west to the arena stair.

21798.name: The Hall of Champions

east.description: To the east lies The Shrine to Devram.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall of Champions.

21798.description:
The end of the hall is a great arch carved with a design of crossed
swords and a rising sun. Two braziers burn on either side of it, their
flames tinted blue with salts. The floor is clean and the air smells of
resin. East lies the shrine itself, and the long hall runs back west.

21799.name: The Shrine to Devram

west.description: To the west lies The Hall of Champions.

21799.description:
The Shrine to Devram is a small round chamber domed like an inverted
bowl, with a polished slab of black stone at its centre. Candle stubs by
the hundred crowd its edges, left by champions seeking a god's favour. A
carving of a bearded warrior with a drawn blade looks down from the
dome. The only way out is back west along the hall.

extra_descs.carving warrior dome devram:
The carved warrior wears no helm and has a rising sun on his breast.
Beneath his feet is cut a single word in elf script: Devram.

647400.name: giant cave spider
647400.long_desc: A pale cave spider the size of a dog creeps along the rock, its eyes glinting in the dark.
647400.description:
Its bloated body is the colour of old bone and its long legs are tipped
with hooked claws. Strands of fine silk trail from its spinnerets across
the stone.

647401.name: cave elf sentry guard
647401.long_desc: A cave elf sentry stands at watch, his dark eyes fixed on every shadow.
647401.description:
He is lean and grey-skinned, in dark leather studded with silver. A
crossbow hangs at his hip and a spear is in his hands. His look says
that outsiders are not welcome here.

647402.name: dungeon jailer keeper
647402.long_desc: A surly jailer prowls the passage, a ring of keys jangling at his belt.
647402.description:
He is broad for a cave elf, heavy-browed and pale as a cellar mushroom.
A short club swings at his waist and a lantern on a hook lights his
sullen face.

647403.name: arena gladiator fighter
647403.long_desc: An arena gladiator limbers up, swinging a heavy blade with easy strength.
647403.description:
Scars cross his arms and chest, and he wears a half-cuirass of studded
black leather. He grins as you look him over, eager for any fight.

647404.name: cave elf citizen merchant
647404.long_desc: A cave elf citizen strolls past, eyeing you with cool disdain.
647404.description:
He is slim and grey-skinned, in a coat of fine dark wool buttoned with
silver. He keeps his hands well away from his purse and gives you a wide
berth.

647405.name: royal guard cave elf elite
647405.long_desc: A cave elf royal guard stands rigid, a long halberd gleaming in his hands.
647405.description:
He wears silver-chased black plate and a helm with a visor like a closed
eye. He does not blink, and he does not seem to breathe.

647406.name: royal war mage cave elf elite
647406.long_desc: A royal war mage waits in a swirl of dusk-coloured robes, sparks gathering on his fingers.
647406.description:
His robes are the colour of the deep cave and his eyes shine pale
violet. A staff of blackened wood crackles with threads of light in his
grip.

647407.name: champion vharel unbroken arena
647407.long_desc: Vharel the Unbroken, champion of the arena, stands in the sand with a bloodied blade resting on his shoulder.
647407.description:
He is tall and lean, his grey skin a map of old scars and his hair bound
in a silver cord. Dozens of chains hang about his neck, each one for a
rival who fell. His smile is calm and cold.

647408.name: cave elf king ilvareth
647408.long_desc: Ilvareth, the Cave Elf King, sits upon his black iron throne, watching you with cold, patient eyes.
647408.description:
The king is tall and gaunt, in robes of violet and silver and a mantle
of black spider silk. A thin circlet of silver crowns his white hair,
and his gaze is old and merciless. A slender sword rests across his
knees.

747400.name: spear steel cave elf
747400.room_desc: A slender cave elf spear lies here.
747400.description: A long spear with a head of dark steel and a shaft bound in grey leather. A leaf is etched near the point.

747401.name: lantern glow glass
747401.room_desc: A glowstone lantern burns softly here.
747401.description: A small lantern of silver and green glass holding a pale stone that gives a steady light.

747402.name: mail cuirass studded black
747402.room_desc: A studded black cuirass lies here.
747402.description: A tough cuirass of black leather studded with silver, its edges worn by many blows.

747403.name: mace spiked champion silver
747403.room_desc: A spiked silver mace lies here.
747403.description: A heavy mace with a head of hammered silver bristling with short black spikes. Notches mark the haft, one for each victory.

747404.name: circlet silver crown sapphire
747404.room_desc: A silver circlet set with sapphires lies here.
747404.description: A thin circlet of old silver set with one deep blue sapphire above the brow. It is cold to the touch.
